module Base
{
    /* Synthetic. A commented-out item and a nested comment: neither is a code.
       /* nested */
    item Commented
    {
        Icon = Axe,
    }
    */

    /* Synthetic: an icon that exists only in UI.pack, with a lowercase key. */
    item Hammer_Fixture
    {
        DisplayCategory = Tool,
        icon = Hammer,
    }

    /* Synthetic: obsolete, disabled and debug-only items never reach ScriptManager. */
    item ObsoleteThing
    {
        Icon = Axe,
        OBSOLETE = true,
    }

    item DisabledThing
    {
        Icon = Axe,
        enabled = false,
    }

    item DebugThing
    {
        Icon = Axe,
        DebugOnly = true,
    }

    /* Synthetic: the texture the item names is in no pack. */
    item MissingTexture
    {
        Icon = NoSuchTexture,
    }

    /* Synthetic: moveables whose sprite is missing, or that name none. */
    item Mov_MissingSprite
    {
        ItemType = base:moveable,
        Icon = default,
        WorldObjectSprite = nowhere_01_0,
    }

    item Mov_NoSprite
    {
        ItemType = base:moveable,
        Icon = default,
    }

    /* Synthetic: a second definition of Base.Axe, which the game takes as the same item. */
    item Axe
    {
        Icon = Hammer,
    }

    /* Real excerpt of an entity: its input line names an item, but it is not an item definition. */
    entity WoodStake
    {
        component UiConfig
        {
            xuiSkin = default,
            entityStyle = ES_Wood_Stake,
            uiEnabled = false,
        }
        component SpriteConfig
        {
            isThumpable = false,
            face W
            {
                layer
                {
                    row = fencing_01_19,
                }
            }
        }
        component CraftRecipe
        {
            timedAction = BuildWoodenStructureSmall,
            time = 200,
            xpAward = Woodwork:6,
            category = Outdoors,
            Tags = Carpentry,
            Tooltip = Tooltip_craft_woodenStakeDesc,
            inputs
            {
                item 1 [Base.Plank],
            }
        }
    }
}
